name: Jotun, Rune
body:
RUNE JOTUN
CR 22/MR 9

This giant’s skin is black and pitted, like roughly cast iron, and etched with glowing red runes.

XP 614,400
LE Gargantuan humanoid (giant, mythic)
Init +0/–20, dual initiative; Senses low-light vision, true seeing; Perception +29
Aura maddening runes (30 ft., DC 25)

DEFENSE

AC 42, touch 6, flat-footed 42 (+12 armor, +24 natural, –4 size)
hp 362 (20d8+272)
Fort +16, Ref +6, Will +20
Defensive Abilities fortification (50%), second save, sword parry; DR 10/epic; Immune cold, electricity, fire; SR 37

OFFENSE

Speed 35 ft. (50 ft. without armor); air walk
Melee +3 adamantine earthbreaker +31/+26/+21 (4d8+37/19–20/x3) or 2 slams +28 (2d6+17)
Ranged mwk spear +12/+7/+2 (4d6+17/×3)
Space 20 ft.; Reach 20 ft.
Special Attacks command giants, mythic power (9/day, surge +1d10), runes (DC 25), spark shower (DC 30)
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 20th; concentration +25)

Constant—air walk, true seeing
At will—charm person (DC 16), suggestion (DC 18)
3/day—mass charm monster (DC 23), dominate person (DC 20)
1/day—demand (DC 23)

STATISTICS

Str 45, Dex 11, Con 30, Int 14, Wis 23, Cha 20
Base Atk +15; CMB +36; CMD 46
Feats Awesome Blow, Critical Focus, Improved Bull Rush, Improved Critical (earthbreaker), Improved Vital Strike, Iron Will, Power Attack, Quick Draw, Staggering Critical, Vital Strike MF
Skills Acrobatics +15 (+23 to jump without armor), Craft (any one) +25, Knowledge (history) +12, Knowledge (nobility) +12, Perception +29
Languages Common, Giant, Terran

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Command Giant (Su)

A rune jotun gains a +6 racial bonus on the save DC of charm or compulsion effects used against giants.

Additionally, a rune jotun can expend one use of mythic power as a free action to force a giant to make two saves to resist one of its charm or compulsion effects and use the lower roll.

Maddening Runes (Su)

The runes covering a rune jotun’s body seem to flicker, shift, and undulate in a subtle, yet maddening, geometry-defying display. All creatures that begin their turn within 30 feet of a rune jotun that can see the giant must succeed on a DC 25 Will save each round or take one point of Wisdom damage and become sickened for as long as they remain within 30 feet of the rune jotun, plus one round. This is a mind-affecting effect and the save DC is Charisma-based. A rune jotun can grant a creature within 60 feet immunity to this effect (or terminate the immunity) as a swift action.

Runes (Su)

As a free action, whenever a rune jotun uses its spark shower or spell-like abilities, it can cause the runes on its body to flash with light. All creatures within 10 feet of the rune jotun must succeed on a DC 25 Fortitude save or be permanently blinded. Creatures that succeed on the save are only dazzled for one round. The saving throw is Charisma-based.

Spark Shower (Su)

As a standard action, a rune jotun can cause a shower of sparks to erupt out of one of the runes on its body.

These sparks function as a breath weapon (30-ft. cone; 12d6 fire and 12d6 electricity damage; Reflex DC 30 half; usable once every 1d4 rounds). The save DC is Constitution-based.

Warhammer Parry (Ex)

Once per round as a free action, when a rune jotun is hit by a melee or ranged attack and it has a hammer of any kind in hand, the rune jotun can attempt a melee attack with the hammer using its full base attack bonus. If the rune jotun’s attack roll exceeds the attack roll made against it, the rune jotun is unaffected by the attack (as if the attack had missed), and the giant can expend one use of mythic power as a free action to attempt a sunder combat maneuver against the weapon it just blocked. When using this ability, the giant is treated as if it had the Improved Sunder feat.

ECOLOGY

Environment cold mountains
Organization solitary, or company (13–30 rune giants, and 2–4 rune giant fighters or rogues of 2nd–4th level, 1 rune giant oracle or sorcerer of 5th–8th level, 1 rune jotun ranger or monk commander of 5th–6th level, 10–20 yetis, 1–4 cloud giants, 8–12 frost giants, 10–16 stone giants, 4–8 lamia matriarchs, and 1–2 adult blue dragons)
Treasure double (+3 adamantine earthbreaker, +3 full plate armor, 3 masterwork spears, other treasure)

Among the largest of all giantkind, rune jotuns epitomize domination by force—both magical and martial—and subject lesser beings to their foul rule via mind-twisting magic and sheer strength. As tyrannically cruel as they are massive, these terrors sport the tusked visage of a demonic mask, skin as black as volcanic glass, and crimson hair that invokes thoughts of both fire and blood. Rune jotuns are 40 feet tall and weigh 25,000 pounds.

Many jotuns have mastered the mystic secrets of the runes (using the runecaster simple template on page 97), with storm jotuns often being particularly adept at such magics, but rune jotuns have taken mastery of mystic writings a step further. Their ebon skin is covered in dozens of ancient runes, which range in size from inches to feet. These characters of legend are neither tattoos nor scarifications, a rune giant’s markings appear at birth, and serve as the unfiltered manifestations of their unknowable powers over the mind and body. This latticework of sigils pulses faintly with the jotuns heart and flashes with fury when the jotun unleashes its supernatural powers of domination or destruction.

While many jotuns seek leadership among their lesser kin in order to wield power over other creatures, rune jotuns focus their ambitions for dominion upon giantkind itself, becoming shadowy boogeymen to most other giants, while smaller humanoids scarcely realize they exist at all. They are relatively few in number, exerting dominion over lesser giants (and rarely other humanoids), seldom seen directly as they work from behind the scenes to manipulate those around them.
